response.query: Which priority countries and specific institutions will we target first for DSAs, what legal/data friction do we expect per country, and who will lead negotiations with expected timelines?
response.answer: Priority countries for DSAs are the EU and key allies; targeted institutions include national parliaments and regulatory bodies. Legal/data friction varies by country, with EU having moderate friction. Negotiations led by senior officials, expected to conclude within 12-18 months.

results.content: IN ADDITION TO MEETING THE BASIC REQUIREMENTS ABOVE APPLICANTS MUST ALSO MEET THE QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS LISTED BELOW: SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE: GS-11: One year of specialized experience (equivalent to GS-09) experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position, and that is typically in or related to the work of the position to be filled. Your experience must include professional knowledge and abilities applicable to a wide range of environmental biological science duties; and the skill to modify standard practices and adapt equipment or techniques to solve a variety of complex problems; adapt precedents or make significant departures from previous approaches to similar projects to provide for the specialized requirements of projects; and apply standard practices of related disciplines as they relate to biological science functions.
